utterance: The `checkout-vpc` VPC (10.30.0.0/16) carries the checkout service's front subnet `checkout-front-a`, and nothing in it is load-balanced yet. Launch a t2.micro EC2 instance in `checkout-front-a` to serve checkout traffic, and put an internal network load balancer in that subnet in front of the checkout service: give the load balancer a TCP listener on port 80 whose default action forwards to a new instance-type target group on TCP port 80 in `checkout-vpc`, and register the checkout service's serving instances in that target group on port 80.

main.responsibility: owns the application's resources and their configuration
main.intent: checkout-vpc runs a new t2.micro instance in checkout-front-a and an internal network load balancer in that same subnet, carrying a TCP listener on port 80 whose single default action forwards to a new instance-type target group on TCP port 80 in checkout-vpc; that target group's registered targets on port 80 are exactly the checkout service's instances that are taking traffic in that same final state
